record_title: Strict alpha-filtration of logarithmically monotone Marcinkiewicz kernels
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result concerns Huang's explicit 2026 Marcinkiewicz construction and proves a strict alpha-ordered kernel filtration with exact concentration-threshold probes. It does not classify arbitrary logarithmically monotone seminorms, does not assert pairwise abstract non-isomorphism of the kernels, does not classify full symmetry of the endpoint X_1, and does not claim a noncommutative analogue. Earlier Kalton--Sukochev work on nonsymmetric singular functionals is prior art rather than part of the novelty claim.
